title: OpenPlanr Task frontmatter (v1.0.0)
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a task artifact. Encodes two orthogonal correlations via `allOf`: (1) type-to-agent — UI tasks use frontend-agent, Tech tasks use backend-agent or db-agent; (2) parent reference — spec-driven tasks (T-NNN-{slug}.md under <SPEC_DIR>/tasks/) carry `specId: "SPEC-NNN"` (with a `storyId` pointing at a US-NNN within that SPEC), default-mode tasks (output/feats/feat-{slug}/us-N/tasks/task-N.md) carry `featureSlug: "<slug>"` instead of specId. Exactly one of the two parent-reference fields must be present per task; the other must be absent.

id.description: Task identifier (e.g. T-001). Scoped to the parent SPEC (spec-driven) or parent User Story (default mode).

storyId.description: ID of the parent User Story this task belongs to.

specId.description: ID of the grandparent spec this task ultimately belongs to. Spec-driven mode only — must be absent in default mode.

featureSlug.description: Slug of the parent feature folder this task ultimately belongs to. Default mode only — must be absent in spec-driven mode.

slug.description: URL-safe lowercase slug used in the task file name.

schemaVersion.description: Pinned to the OpenPlanr Protocol reader version.

type.description: UI = frontend-bearing task; Tech = backend / data / infra task.

agent.description: DEV agent responsible for executing this task. Must correlate with `type` (see allOf type/agent branch).

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) bumped on every edit.

oneOf.title: spec-driven task → requires specId, forbids featureSlug
default-mode task → requires featureSlug, forbids specId
